authority.parameter_source: Each upstream/registry/snap-cn/<id>/config.ts owns its dimensions, fps, frame count and controls; its index.tsx owns geometry and motion. Demo.tsx owns the fixed local demonstration bindings. Canvas below describes the default phone-frame preview, not a shared timeline for all effects.

canvas.clock: Default phone-frame: 240 frames at 30fps. Selecting another independent composition uses that component's native config; reel-wall is 24fps and search-typing is 60fps. No speech clock and no audio.

narrative.purpose: Browse and select 53 independent local motion demonstrations; not a complete talking-head template.
structure: Play or scrub its native timeline

scenes.purpose: Default phone-frame demonstration; other selected effects replace this whole composition with native config timing.

assets.source: User-authorized existing local venue, robot, family and robot-dog footage; private per-run materials.json records source hashes and derived asset hashes.
embedded_content: Venue signs and people remain baked into the source frames.
assets.rights_status: Private demonstrations only; not redistributed with source.

assets.source: Eight stills extracted from the same authorized local videos.
embedded_content: Real-world image contents are not separately editable.

assets.source: Caller-supplied local Chinese font and declared FontFace cache; per-run materials.json records hashes.
assets.rights_status: Font files remain in the local preview cache.

assets.source: prepare_snapcn_demo.py draws a simple H demonstration symbol.

elements.role: The selected native Snapcn motion component, treated as one catalogue item. Its public controls retain the original config and index.tsx as geometry and state authority.

content.description: Demo.tsx catalogue[id].props supplies Chinese content and local assets. Subtitle timings and data values are illustrative.

style.overflow: Native component masks and the outer viewport clip apply. This is a native landscape preview; portrait reflow is not asserted.

states.description: Entry, transitions and exit come from the selected native source. Empty backgrounds at an authored entry/exit are part of the effect demo, not an approved talking-head scene.

constraints.rule: Only registered free component IDs; local assets and fixed demo content; no paid provider calls.

acceptance.method: Switch all 53 catalogue items and inspect three representative frames per component.
acceptance.pass_condition: No component exception; local media visible where applicable; representative visual state matches the named effect.

evidence.method: Pinned full free-source catalogue and per-file SHA256.

evidence.source: User requested all free components and simple local-material demonstrations.
evidence.method: One preview at a time with common local media and declared font adaptation.

structure.note: Run schema and local catalogue interface checks.

technical.note: Current queue and per-component frame results are recorded privately under .local/snapcn-gallery/.

visual.note: Actual representative-frame review is separate from successful rendering.

audio.note: Silent motion demonstrations; no new speech or music.

platform.note: Desktop in-app browser only; social-platform and another physical machine are not validated.

user_review.note: User will browse and choose effects.

production.note: Local library and preview producer only; automated complete talking-head templates are a later task.

graphic.text_policy: Chinese caller-supplied local font for normal content; Latin font-shuffle sample preserves visible typeface differences. Timing for caption examples is illustrative, not ASR evidence.
graphic.asset_fit: Native source masks and cover/contain policies are retained. Inputs are private local footage, stills and project-authored symbol.

component_catalogue.contract: 53 independent variants from the exact free registry; one active variant at a time.
rules: Native per-ID config overrides the default canvas fps and duration when selected.
Demo.tsx is shared by Player and representative-frame rendering.
No Pro components or templates are fetched.
Google font imports use declared local fallback; explicit FontFace resources are cached locally.
No claim of arbitrary portrait reflow or whole-video production readiness.

operations.entrypoint: ../../scripts/motion_components.py list|serve; build.cjs build; registered ../../scripts/motion_components_preview.py for queued representative frames
operations.input: Pinned catalogue, declared extra dependencies, existing shared React/Remotion host, private local demonstration assets and materials.json.
operations.action: Build the local player; serve only localhost; freeze the local preview request and submit the registered queue handler; review actual images and browser behavior.
operations.output: Interactive effect catalogue, local query interface, per-component representative images, posters and private review evidence.
operations.completion: All 53 free IDs are present and playable; each has representative images; affected visual and interaction checks recorded without extrapolating to full talking-head production.
operations.recovery: Read private preview-job.json and original queue/log. Preserve completed images; rebuild changed code/assets into a new frozen request. No provider generation or publication is part of this action.
